messages:
Alyssa Chen: Team — DataCity LLM Summit next month. Panel submission for 'Serving at Scale' is in, but we still need to confirm: lightning talk speaker, final swag SKU list, vendor deadlines, and the lead capture -> CRM flow. Can we assign owners? :spiral_calendar:

Mike Patel: I can take shipping and on-site setup. Need vendor lead time and the official booth footprint from the venue to plan crates.

Sylvia Nguyen: Creative can finish print-ready art by Tue. Draft swag proposal: vinyl stickers (2200), embroidered patches (550), portable chargers (140), crewneck sweatshirts (48). Also a limited-run recycled tote (200) — eco option. I'll mock up a backdrop with the latest benchmark curve.

Jordan Ruiz: I'll own speaker submissions and the inbound lead flow. Tentative lead path: QR on table -> short Typeform -> Segment event -> SFDC Lead creation into queue "Events/Leads" with AE rotation. Minimal form: name, email, company, role, interest checkbox, opt-in. Any objections to Typeform vs HubSpot? Typeform keeps it quick on mobile.

Priya Kaur: Growth to run an attendee breakfast meetup and a post-conference webinar series. We'll need utm_medium + session_tag on the Typeform redirect so we can stitch to the nurture sequence.

Ram Singh: AV + power + lead-scanner on my plate. Venue requires Certificate of Insurance (COI) on file by 2026-06-01. What's the largest crate we'll ship? Freight elevator max is 46" x 34".

Alyssa Chen: Vendor lead time is 6 business days per vendor email. Sylvia 14 please cut PO once final counts approved. Mike 14 I'll escalate freight if we need rush.

Sylvia Nguyen: Finalized counts after double-check: stickers 2200, patches 550, chargers 140, crewnecks 48, totes 200. Crewneck sizes: S(9), M(18), L(15), XL(6). Uploading assets tonight.

Sylvia Nguyen: Upload link (mock): https://drive.redwood.app/marketing/datacity-2026-art. Files: `backdrop_final.pdf`, `sticker_layout.ai`, `patch_vector.svg`, `crewneck_front.psd`, `tote_print.ai`.

Mike Patel: Shipping plan draft:
```
Ship-to: Redwood Events / Mike Patel
Attn: Mike Patel
Venue: DataCity Conference Center, Hall B, Booth B12
Ship window: 2026-06-09 to 2026-06-11
Carrier: Compare FedEx vs local LTL freight
Special: freight elevator 46"x34"; crate max 44"x32"
```
Also need booth buddy schedule for setup and teardown.

Jordan Ruiz: Speaker update: Panelists confirmed: Alyssa (Marketing), Dr. L. Chen (ML Infra), Marco (PartnerX). Lightning talk backup: Priya offered a 10-min demo. We should prepare a 2-slide summary with sanitized benchmark numbers for the panel.

Priya Kaur: I can do the 10-min demo if chosen. Working title: "Three quick levers to halve your inference spend". Will need a couple of data points + demo script. Also drafting the webinar follow-up cadence (3 emails + 1 CTA to trial).

Ram Singh: Quick benchmark snippet for slides (sanitized):
```
Baseline throughput: 40 tps
Optimized throughput: 93 tps (+2.33x)
Median p95 latency: 90ms -> 70ms
Token cost: $0.011 -> $0.0049 (quantization + batching)
```
I'll add these to a 1-slide PDF for presenters.

Jordan Ruiz: Typeform -> Segment -> SFDC mapping plan:
- typeform.email -> sf_contact.email
- typeform.company -> sf_account.name
- typeform.role -> sf_lead.title
- typeform.interest -> sf_lead.Use_Case__c
- segment.traits.utm_source -> sf_campaign
Also planning a Slack webhook to #sales-events with a short summary for each qualified lead. @DevEx can you confirm the webhook endpoint?

DevEx: Webhook to #sales-events exists. Share a test payload and I'll validate routing.

Jordan Ruiz: Test payload (example):
```
{
  "email": "test+dc2026@redwood.ai",
  "company": "ExampleCo",
  "role": "ML Platform",
  "interest": "inference-cost",
  "utm_source": "qr_dc2026"
}
```
Tested end-to-end -> Segment event recorded -> SFDC Lead created and assigned to Events queue. Will post logs.

Sylvia Nguyen: Small ask: can we print 500 small QR cards (2.5" x 3.5") with speaker QR linking to the benchmark blog? Copy idea: "See the numbers: how we cut inference cost 2x. Scan for benchmarks, demo & trial." CTA: "Get the benchmarks". I'll wireframe the card.

Mike Patel: Venue note: if we need curbside lift for any crate over truck lift threshold, cost estimate is ~$220. Approve? @Alyssa

Alyssa Chen: Approve the lift. Add it to the PO and include insurance line item.

booth-bot: Reminder: swag production cutoff in 5 days per vendor SLA.

Ram Singh: COI uploaded to venue portal. Reserved an extra demo table and confirmed power access. Also ordered a handheld lead scanner.

Jordan Ruiz: Typeform preview link: https://typeform.com/to/mock (mock). QR redirect set to https://redwood.ai/datacity/benchmarks?utm_source=qr_dc2026. Will share Zap/Segment logs after another test run.

Priya Kaur: I'll draft the breakfast invite list and webinar nurture sequence. Planning 3-touch email series: Day0 (thanks + benchmarks), Day3 (short case study), Day7 (invite to on-demand demo).

Alyssa Chen: Action recap:
- Mike: finalize carrier & add lift to PO, publish booth-buddy schedule
- Sylvia: upload print-ready files + QR card art, submit PO
- Jordan: submit lightning slot/biographies, finalize Typeform mapping, share test logs
- Priya: confirm lightning talk content + draft webinar nurture
- Ram: finalize AV rig, COI, freight coord
I'll check back in 24 hours. :rocket:

Mike Patel: On it. Will post carrier options by EOD.

Jordan Ruiz: Speaker bios + headshots uploaded. Submitting lightning slot tonight.

Priya Kaur: Confirmed for lightning demo. Drafting the follow-up email sequence.

Alyssa Chen: Great work team. Closing thread unless anyone has blockers. :white_check_mark:
